summary: Phase 1 Security & User Account Management E2E validated. Backend: 19/19 tests pass covering password policy, change-password, force-reset, lockout (5-attempt→HTTP 423), status enforcement, admin session termination, refresh, security audit log, and owner seeding. Frontend: Fixed 3 CRITICAL bugs blocking the app entirely + validated Profile page, ChangePassword (non-forced & forced), Users admin controls, and profile-link in sidebar. Sales password ended at 'Ir@2026Safe' with account_status=active as requested.

critical_bugs_found_and_fixed.issue: AuthProvider was wrapping BrowserRouter, but AuthContext uses useNavigate() which requires a Router ancestor. Result: entire app crashed on load with 'useNavigate() may be used only in the context of a <Router> component' + blank white page.
critical_bugs_found_and_fixed.rca: Ordering error introduced during Phase 1 rewrite of AuthContext (added useNavigate at line 20).

critical_bugs_found_and_fixed.issue: Route <ChangePassword forced /> hardcoded the forced prop to true, so users clicking 'Change Password' from Profile page (non-forced flow) got the forced UI with cp-current field hidden. Impossible to change password normally.
critical_bugs_found_and_fixed.fix: Removed forced prop from route; ChangePassword derives isForced from user.password_reset_required.

critical_bugs_found_and_fixed.issue: Two independent redirects fought each other: (a) `if (user) return <Navigate to='/' replace />` at line 18 hijacked to `/` immediately after setUser fired, overriding the nav('/change-password') from AuthContext.login(). (b) submit()'s own nav('/') was unconditional. Effect: users flagged password_reset_required were dumped into the dashboard instead of the forced-reset screen.
critical_bugs_found_and_fixed.fix: Changed the top-level guard to `<Navigate to={user.password_reset_required ? '/change-password' : '/'} replace />` and made submit() nav respect data?.password_reset_required.

critical_bugs_found_and_fixed.issue: Missing data-testid='profile-link' on the sidebar user-name area (spec required it). The name area was a plain <div>, not a link to /profile.
critical_bugs_found_and_fixed.fix: Converted the user-name/role block into a <Link to='/profile' data-testid='profile-link'>.

backend_verified.change_password_happy_path: 200 + fresh cookies + old token invalidated + new password logs in
backend_verified.force_reset: 200 → target account_status=password_reset_required + old bearer invalidated (401 on /auth/me) + user can login (prr=true) + can change with empty current + status flips to active
backend_verified.failed_login_lockout: 5th failure → 423 + account_status=locked; 6th correct pw still 423; admin unlock → 200; correct login works
backend_verified.status_enforcement_suspended: login → 403 'Your account is suspended'; existing token → 401/403 (tv bumped)
backend_verified.admin_logout_user: target token → 401 on /auth/me; target can re-login

not_directly_tested: inactivity-modal visual (verified via code inspection at AuthContext.jsx line 101 — data-testid exists, appears at warnTimerRef fire; not triggerable within reasonable test time as spec allows)
action_items: None required for retest — all critical bugs fixed & verified. Main agent may optionally: (1) remove pytest.mark.order (unused/no plugin), (2) address minor code-review items below.
critical_code_review_comments: AuthContext.jsx line 91 also calls nav('/change-password') — now redundant with the Login.jsx guard fix. Not harmful but consider centralising in one place.

server.py: /users/{uid}/unlock does not bump token_version — arguably safe (only clears lock, doesn't re-authorise). But consider whether unlocking a still-active session should invalidate anything. Currently OK.
ChangePassword.jsx handles both forced and non-forced via one page — the forced route in App.js should also pass a redirect target; currently forced submit navigates to '/'.

Route /change-password now works because ChangePassword auto-derives forced from user.password_reset_required. If user directly navigates while forced, redirect is not automatic — but this is fine since /login flow catches it.
backend/server.py file is 1890 lines — approaching monolith threshold. Recommend splitting into routers/{auth,users,leads,suppliers,security}.py for maintainability.
seed_data_creation: test_failed_login_lockout creates & deletes test_lockme@example.com within the test
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sales password is now 'Ir@2026Safe' (not the legacy sales123). Fixed 3 blocker/high frontend bugs in this iteration — verify no regressions. Backend endpoints for Phase 1 security are stable & fully covered by /app/backend/tests/test_auth_security.py — run it with `REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> pytest -o addopts='' backend/tests/test_auth_security.py`. Use `pytest.mark.order` is a no-op (plugin not installed) — can be removed. inactivity-modal is code-only verified; if time-based test needed, mock setTimeout.
rca_of_the_issue: Phase 1 rewrite introduced useNavigate() in AuthContext but did not update App.js to wrap AuthProvider with BrowserRouter. Additionally the /change-password route was hardcoded to forced mode and Login.jsx did not distinguish password_reset_required from a normal login. All three bugs together made the app either crash entirely or route users incorrectly. Fixes preserve backward compatibility for legacy accounts and correctly enforce the forced-reset UX.
